responsibilities: Build and maintain company dashboards: product, sales, marketing, finance
Product analytics: feature adoption, engagement, retention, funnel analysis
Sales analytics: pipeline reporting, conversion rates, deal velocity
Marketing analytics: campaign performance, attribution, channel efficiency
Financial reporting support: MIS, investor updates, unit economics tracking
Ad-hoc analysis: answer data questions from any department within 24 hours
Data quality: validation, cleaning, documentation of data sources
Automated reporting: weekly/monthly reports scripted and scheduled

primary.target: All recurring reports scripted by Q2

weeklyLoop.monday: Update all dashboards with latest data. Flag anomalies.
weeklyLoop.tuesday: Product analytics deep-dive: feature usage, engagement trends.
weeklyLoop.wednesday: Sales and marketing analytics: campaign ROI, pipeline health.
weeklyLoop.thursday: Ad-hoc analysis: handle data requests from leadership.
weeklyLoop.friday: Data report to CTO: key metrics, insights, anomalies, recommendations.

escalateToCEO: Metrics that indicate existential risk (e.g., negative LTV:CAC)
